purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official local publications identify AMCO as cadastral manager; public ArcGIS metadata returned HTTP 200, Polygon, EPSG:9377, safe OBJECTID. Bounded query around the unchanged WUP locator returned HTTP 200 and three polygons, with only OBJECTID requested. Dataset title is Terreno Catastro AMCO; interpretation is physical/ground cadastral geometry only.
registryAssessment: Pereira’s official publications identify AMCO as the gestor catastral for the municipality. The official SIGPER web map references an AMCO terrain-cadastre layer; a public FeatureServer serves polygon geometry. Bounded response is labeled Terreno and is treated only as a physical ground/terrain cadastral unit, not a legal property-right, title or ownership register.
